name: Saluzzo (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with a yellow ornamental letter S formed of a dolphin.
history: Municipal flag of Saluzzo, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: ornamental letter S in the form of a dolphin
